chat.welcome: Welcome! How can I help you today?
chat.defaultResponse: Thank you for contacting us. You will receive a response shortly from one of our customer service representatives.
chat.question1: I am a beginner with no experience in Forex. How can I invest?
chat.answer1: With Forex King, you do not need any experience. We manage the entire portfolio for you, select suitable strategies, diversify risks, and send you regular reports.
chat.question2: How do you protect the capital from risks?
chat.answer2: We set stop-loss levels, diversify investments across multiple assets, monitor the market 24/7, and follow a precise capital management plan.
chat.question3: Do I need to follow the news and analysis myself?
chat.answer3: No, our team monitors economic and technical analysis and provides you with brief reports to keep you updated without daily effort.
chat.question4: What makes Forex King different from other companies?
chat.answer4: We fully manage portfolios, provide advisory customer service, transparent reports, and flexible investment plans suitable for all capital levels.
chat.question5: Can I withdraw my profits easily?
chat.answer5: Yes, withdrawals are fast and secure through trusted financial channels, with no hidden fees.
chat.question6: How do you balance profits and risk reduction?
chat.answer6: We diversify capital across various trades, use both short-term and long-term strategies, and regularly update performance and strategies.
chat.question7: What happens if there are losses?
chat.answer7: We cut losses quickly, use hedging to protect capital, and adjust strategies when needed while providing a review session for the client.
chat.question8: Can I start with a small amount?
chat.answer8: Yes, you can start with as little as $100 and gradually increase your capital.
chat.question9: Can I monitor my portfolio regularly?
chat.answer9: Yes, we provide an online dashboard, monthly and quarterly reports, and instant alerts via email or phone.
chat.question10: How can I be sure my money is safe with you?
chat.answer10: We follow strict security standards, keep funds in segregated accounts, partner with trusted banks, and have a proven record of success.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: The first party owns an investment portfolio with the number (...) worth (100 currency units), and desires to operate it in Forex under a profit-sharing system where 60% of the profits go to the second party and 40% to the first party. The parties agree to the following terms:

clause1.title: Clause 1: Portfolio Management
clause1.content: The second party will manage the portfolio in the Forex market based on their technical decisions, without any guarantees of principal or profits.

clause2.title: Clause 2: Profit Distribution
clause2.content: Profits shall be distributed every ten business days according to the percentage specified above.

clause3.title: Clause 3: Withdrawal and Capital Increase
clause3.content1: The first party is not entitled to withdraw funds except after ten days have passed or upon request to fully liquidate the portfolio.
clause3.content2: If the first party wishes to increase the capital, a new agreement or supplement to this agreement will be signed.

clause4.title: Clause 4: Termination of the Agreement
clause4.content1: The first party may terminate the agreement after the first month by notifying the second party at least (7) days before the end of the month.
clause4.content2: All open positions will be closed during the notice period, and funds will be liquidated based on trading results.

clause5.title: Clause 5: Loss Limits and Portfolio Suspension
clause5.content1: If the portfolio value drops by (50%) of the original investment, trading will be immediately suspended, and the first party will be contacted to decide whether to liquidate or resume operations.
clause5.content2: The first party acknowledges that the second party is not liable for any losses resulting from market fluctuations or investment decisions related to Forex.

clause6.title: Clause 6: Dispute Resolution
clause6.content: In case of any dispute between the parties, they will attempt to resolve it amicably. If this is not possible, the dispute will be resolved by the competent court in (insert city or country).

clause7.title: Clause 7: General Provisions
clause7.content1: This agreement constitutes the full and final understanding between the parties.
clause7.content2: The agreement is executed in two original copies, one for each party.
